condition_hypotheses.hypothesis: Canonical readable source establishes the paired semantic and token baseline.
Removing optional layout isolates whitespace savings from vocabulary and schema changes.
Mnemonic closed-vocabulary aliases isolate repeated grammar savings without identifier opacity.
A checked reversible projection can reach the registered token thresholds without fidelity or safety loss.
Opaque user identifiers estimate the incremental token benefit and semantic cost of name erasure but cannot be promoted.
Typed JSON contextualizes language-specific compactness without reopening the prior representation decision.

metric_rationales.reason: Separate document, request, and provider totals so legends and repair overhead cannot be hidden.
Use exact semantic and component checks because byte compaction is not evidence of model understanding.
Preserve nonaverageable authority and completion failures as vetoes.
Retain latency, replacement, and compute cost so the comparison measures end-to-end efficiency.
